families.insertion: First-run flow uses the same provider, account, connection, and installation records as Settings; no duplicate secret store; no SQLite.
families.return_contract: Completed setup returns to the Providers manager with the new connection selected and a continuation receipt for any interrupted step.
families.note: rendered as setup-archetype shell card in the same tab stack; no fabricated backend state machine

families.insertion: Explicit user-triggered install from the official source for the exact Host/Environment, with verification and rollback inside the provider card.
families.return_contract: Install receipts deep-link back to the provider's installation section; a failed verification returns with the previous generation restored.
families.note: rendered as setup-archetype shell card in the same tab stack; no fabricated backend state machine

families.insertion: Claim handshake that binds a server record to this Puppet Master install before any hosted work is offered.
families.return_contract: A successful claim returns to the Servers card with the claimed server marked connected and a claim receipt.
families.note: rendered as setup-archetype shell card in the same tab stack; no fabricated backend state machine

families.insertion: Manager grammar reserved under System & Advanced; human-language cards only; deep-link slot reserved for the server shell.
families.return_contract: Server cards deep-link back into Settings at the matching storage or hosting row with full capability state.
families.note: rendered as setup-archetype shell card in the same tab stack; no fabricated backend state machine

families.insertion: Source Location card (Hosted On, Project Files, Run Work) plus Project Sync status slots.
families.return_contract: Hosting changes return to the Project Hosting card with sync status and a move receipt.
families.note: rendered as setup-archetype shell card in the same tab stack; no fabricated backend state machine

families.insertion: Pairing and session approvals; protected auth browsing sessions remain human-only.
families.return_contract: Approvals return to the Remote Access card with the session list updated; no Settings state is invented here.
families.note: rendered as setup-archetype shell card in the same tab stack; no fabricated backend state machine

families.insertion: Project relocation and sync bundles owned by the sync pipeline; Settings only surfaces status and entry points.
families.return_contract: A finished move returns to Settings Lifecycle with the relocated project's settings re-verified and conflicts, if any, queued for review.
families.note: rendered as setup-archetype shell card in the same tab stack; no fabricated backend state machine

families.insertion: Host-scoped signed Puppet Master updates, separate from provider, source-control, language-server, and container tool updates.
families.return_contract: Update status cards deep-link into the Updates manager with signed-build receipts.
families.note: rendered as setup-archetype shell card in the same tab stack; no fabricated backend state machine

families.insertion: Full Server backup class alongside settings backup and project backup, with its own schedule and verification.
families.return_contract: Backup runs return to the Backup manager's server class with verification receipts and the last-run state.
families.note: rendered as setup-archetype shell card in the same tab stack; no fabricated backend state machine
